description: Capabilities for the desktop pet right-click HTML menu window (replaces native NSMenu). All window mutation (show/hide/position/size) goes through custom `pet_menu_*` invoke commands which bypass the ACL, so no `core:window:*` perms are needed here. The menu only needs event access: `emit` for `pet://menu-action` (item click → main window routes via `usePetHostBridge`). The frontend reads current pet size + click-through state via `pet_cursor_probe` (already granted in `default.json`) so the menu can pre-check the size/opacity radio items and the click-through toggle.
